title: OpenAI Presence sells enterprise AI agents with engineers attached
summary: OpenAI Presence is a managed enterprise AI agents product launched on July 22, 2025, available only through limited general availability rather than self-service. The product distinguishes itself by bundling dedicated Forward Deployed Engineers with AI agent deployments to assist enterprise customers with implementation and integration.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge enterprises face when deploying AI agents without adequate technical support, by bundling dedicated engineers with the product.
why_valuable: The combination of AI agents with embedded professional services reduces enterprise implementation risk and accelerates time-to-value for complex deployments.
